correctness.rationale: All 208 original nonempty faces and quotient flags are exhaustively generated. Boundaries are signed over the integers; all ∂² vanish. Direct 124, 462, 300 integer unit-pivot cancellations produce residual ranks (1,0,6,0) without torsion; mod-two ranks and a separate Burnside Euler count corroborate. Chessboard connectivity with ν=3 and Armstrong with a fixed diagonal rook prove π1=1; Hurewicz and homological Whitehead imply the six-sphere wedge. The verifier does not claim to certify the cited general topological theorems.

value.rationale: The first naturally simply connected square chessboard complex has a canonical row-column transpose involution; an exact complete integral orbit-space homotopy type answers a motivated topology problem. The 6-sphere wedge rules out integral 2-torsion and unexpected attaching information that rational ranks, Euler counts, and the known transpose fixed space cannot rule out. Its modest finite scope is openly specified; no unsupported general theorem is claimed.
